page_title: KOL 0-4 DOR | FC Koln v Dortmund 20/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' 0 - 4 It's in the back of the net! Jamie Bynoe-Gittens plays it into the box, and Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 0:4.
90+1' Dortmund keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Justin Diehl (1. FC Koln) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) will replace Jan Thielmann.
87' Timo Schultz prepares a substitution. Rasmus Carstensen is replaced by Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln).
85' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
84' FC Koln failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
84' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) takes a pot shot from distance after a rebound fell kindly for him, but it's blocked by an opponent. FC Koln win a corner.
84' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for FC Koln.
82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) was quite harsh and Daniel Schlager didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

79' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Gregor Kobel!
79' FC Koln have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
78' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

77' Marco Reus (Dortmund) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger. The ball goes out of play. Dortmund are awarded a corner kick.
76' Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
74' Substitution. Salih Ozcan makes way for Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund).
74' Here is a change. Niclas Fullkrug is going off and Edin Terzic gives the last tactical orders to Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund).
74' The referee allows time for a substitution. Florian Kainz will be replaced by Jacob Christensen (1. FC Koln).
69' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Gregor Kobel.
68' The attendance is 50000.

68' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
66' Substitution. Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) in, Jadon Sancho out.
66' Substitution. Marco Reus (Dortmund) replaces Julian Brandt.
62' Timo Schultz has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Justin Diehl (1. FC Koln) replacing Linton Maina.
62' Here comes a substitution. Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) is brought on as a substitute for Dejan Ljubicic.
61' 0 - 3 Donyell Malen (Dortmund) is released by Ian Maatsen, he surges into the box and smashes a great shot into the net after a one-on-one with the goalkeeper.
58' GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Marvin Schwabe no chance!
58' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

56' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Dortmund are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
53' A pass from Donyell Malen (Dortmund) is intercepted by Marvin Schwabe and the move breaks down.
51' Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) jumps into a tackle and Daniel Schlager signals a foul. Dortmund earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
51' POST! Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the right post. What a strike that was!
50' Dortmund keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
46' Great save! Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Gregor Kobel.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Edin Terzic gives a chance to Hendry Blank (Dortmund) and Niklas Sule is off.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+9' Daniel Schlager has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+9' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
45+8' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Donyell Malen (Dortmund). Dortmund will take a corner kick.
45+8' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
45+7' The corner from Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is intercepted by the defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to FC Koln.

45+7' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player. FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
45+7' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is about to take a corner kick.

45+7' Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. FC Koln will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+6' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
45+6' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
45+6' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) is penalised for holding. Daniel Schlager signals a set piece. FC Koln earn a free kick.
45+1' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) sprays a pass out to Donyell Malen, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
45' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
45' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
45' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. FC Koln force a corner. They send men into the box.
44' Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick.
43' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
43' FC Koln hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
39' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) sprays a pass out to Rasmus Carstensen, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.

37' Thomas Meunier (Dortmund) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner and attempts to finish from the edge of the box. His shot, however, misses the target narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
37' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the corner.

33' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and produces a low shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
30' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
29' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
27' The whistle blows and Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) is booked for an infringement.
27' Flag goes up against Donyell Malen (Dortmund) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
25' Some neat passing and movement from FC Koln as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
22' The linesman signals that Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
21' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
21' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Eric Martel (1. FC Koln), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. It will be a corner kick for FC Koln.
14' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.

12' 0 - 1 The ball hits the back of the net! Julian Brandt delivers the corner, Donyell Malen (Dortmund) finds himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes an unstoppable shot which goes into the bottom left corner and past the helpless goalkeeper. 0:1.
12' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
12' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear. Good work from Dortmund as they win a corner.
11' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Daniel Schlager saw the whole situation. That's a free kick to Dortmund.

10' What a poor attempt! Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
9' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
7' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

4' A sweet pass finds Julian Brandt (Dortmund) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Marvin Schwabe is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
3' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
1' The first half has started.
Dortmund will kick the game off.
Daniel Schlager will referee today's match.
